data.description: Calibration of code-v3 (ticket cranial-goodly-seahog) found finding.criteria labels emitted by the reviewer that are NOT in criteria_routing.json: sec, documentation, logic, clarity, consistency, concurrency, robustness, resource-management, behavior-change, project.review-phase-boundaries. These free-text aliases (sec~=security, documentation~=docs) fall through to the default 0.95 posture and cannot be individually routed, so per-criterion threshold calibration silently misses them. Constrain the reviewer prompt/schema to the registry vocabulary, or add an alias-normalization step.
data.title: Constrain code-review reviewer criteria to the routing registry vocabulary
